skill_name: Create a speech on how technology is changing our day-to-day lives.
workflow: Technology has revolutionized our lives in ways we couldn't have imagined only a few years ago. From the comfort of our homes, we can now order groceries, access entertainment and information, practice our hobbies, and take care of many everyday errands. We have instant access to a wealth of knowledge at our fingertips, from medical and scientific facts to cultural experiences from all around the world.
